import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long mo;
    static long[] fact, factr, inv;
    static boolean init = false;
    static final int MAX = 400001;

    static long modAdd(long a, long b) {
        long r = a + b;
        if (r >= mo) r -= mo;
        return r;
    }

    static long modSub(long a, long b) {
        long r = a - b;
        if (r < 0) r += mo;
        return r;
    }

    static long modMul(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % mo;
    }

    static long modPow(long a, long n) {
        long r = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) r = modMul(r, a);
            a = modMul(a, a);
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long comb(long N_, long C_) {
        if (!init) {
            inv = new long[MAX + 1];
            fact = new long[MAX + 1];
            factr = new long[MAX + 1];
            inv[1] = 1;
            fact[0] = factr[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= MAX; ++i) {
                inv[i] = inv[(int)(mo % i)] * (mo - mo / i) % mo;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= MAX; ++i) {
                fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mo;
                factr[i] = factr[i - 1] * inv[i] % mo;
            }
            init = true;
        }
        if (C_ < 0 || C_ > N_) return 0;
        return factr[(int)C_] * fact[(int)N_] % mo * factr[(int)(N_ - C_)] % mo;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();
        mo = sc.nextLong();
        long[] dp1 = new long[505];
        long[] dp2 = new long[505];
        long[][] dp3 = new long[505][505];
        long[][] dp4 = new long[505][505];

        dp1[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                // dp1[i] += (i+1)*dp1[j-1]*dp1[i-j]*comb(i-1,j-1)
                long t1 = modMul(i + 1, dp1[j - 1]);
                long t2 = modMul(t1, dp1[i - j]);
                long t3 = modMul(t2, comb(i - 1, j - 1));
                dp1[i] = modAdd(dp1[i], t3);

                // dp2[i] part1: (i+1)*(dp2[i-j]*dp1[j-1] + dp1[i-j]*dp2[j-1])*comb(i-1,j-1)
                long partA = modAdd(modMul(dp2[i - j], dp1[j - 1]), modMul(dp1[i - j], dp2[j - 1]));
                long partA1 = modMul(modMul(i + 1, partA), comb(i - 1, j - 1));
                dp2[i] = modAdd(dp2[i], partA1);

                // dp2[i] part2: dp1[j-1]*dp1[i-j]*comb(i-1,j-1)*(comb(j,2)+comb(i-j+1,2))
                long partB = modMul(modMul(dp1[j - 1], dp1[i - j]), comb(i - 1, j - 1));
                long comb1 = comb(j, 2);
                long comb2 = comb(i - j + 1, 2);
                long sumComb = modAdd(comb1, comb2);
                long partB1 = modMul(partB, sumComb);
                dp2[i] = modAdd(dp2[i], partB1);
            }
        }

        dp3[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i - 1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i - 1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    // dp3[i][j] += dp1[l]*dp3[i-l-1][j-l]*comb(j,l)
                    long add3 = modMul(modMul(dp1[l], dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]), comb(j, l));
                    dp3[i][j] = modAdd(dp3[i][j], add3);
                    // dp4[i][j] += (dp1[l]*dp4[i-l-1][j-l] + dp2[l]*dp3[i-l-1][j-l])*comb(j,l)
                    long partC = modAdd(modMul(dp1[l], dp4[i - l - 1][j - l]), modMul(dp2[l], dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]));
                    long add4 = modMul(partC, comb(j, l));
                    dp4[i][j] = modAdd(dp4[i][j], add4);
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = dp1[i];
            dp4[i][i] = dp2[i];
        }

        System.out.println(dp4[N][M]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
